claim: Tracks nutrition, exercise, hydration, sleep, fasting, mood and body measurements; goals, check-ins, charts, reports, multiple profiles, OIDC, TOTP, Passkey
Made of backend server, web frontend and native iOS and Android apps
Sync list: Apple Health, Google Health Connect, Fitbit, Garmin Connect, Withings, Polar Flow, Oura, Hevy; food sources OpenFoodFacts, USDA
Optional AI features in beta: log food, exercise, body stats via chat and food photos
Docker Compose install with .env containing DB password, API encryption key, auth secret and frontend URL; app at port 3004
Source-available, not open source; non-commercial licence requires permission for commercial use
Breaking changes may occur between releases; auto-updating containers not recommended
Sleep stages, HRV and blood glucose are imported and charted, not measured by the app
Family sharing with granular permissions (7 permissions)
Family & Friends access is listed under beta features; food sources include Fatsecret and Nutritionix
